w1_invariance_basis: When bar_count ≤ 20 < 252 (max_bars cap), both kernels process identical raw bars from the same zero integrator state. Equivalence is exact by construction. Any difference is a real bug.
est_divergence_note: Cohort_EST divergence is EXPECTED architectural behavior — full-history vs 252-bar-windowed integrator modes diverge on established-stock bar_counts. This is documented at design doc Section 8 (amendment pending) and is NOT a bug. The deployment-relevant equivalence is Cohort_W1.

Cohort_EST.note: Informational only — not a deployment gate.
